This article is a stub. Sportyme, Inc., of Hatboro, Pennsylvania, was the sales and service
agent for Omega electronic sports timing in the United States in the early and middle 1980s. It
advertised the [OSM6](../equipment/swimming/timers/osm6.md) console and sold general swimming
equipment.

By 1988 the Omega agency had passed to [Kiefer](kiefer.md); see the [vendors](index.md) register
for the companies this wiki covers.
